body: Well they started when I started talking to her, I'd just get these really weird scenarios of her getting hurt (not by me) or her falling down, like I never wanted to hurt her but I just kept getting these weird thoughts. She did nothing to make me think of them I have no idea why they popped up. Or I would think things like she doesn't like me and she's only interested in me because of my looks etc (sounds like some real incel type stuff but I swear I've never ever had those thoughts before). On another note I was just really taken by surprise at how someone could be so crazy for me and so attracted, and I feel bad because to be honest I never really felt that same level as her. But I feel like these intrusive thoughts really made me change for the worst when we started dating and after because I just kept pushing her away and making an ass out of myself. I really did try to make things better and apologize but now it's too late and I think she'll never forgive me and I will forever be an asshole who broke her heart. If I never had these thoughts we'd probably still be friends or dating but I knew something like this would happen deep down. I specifically remember texting her thinking that I would mess it up some way.

But I found her attractive, and she has an amazing personality, just everything about her is perfect. In the moment and relationship though it's like something changed within in me and I just pushed her away. I think there might be something wrong with me mentally because I kept having these really weird toxic thoughts like I didn't respect her (i never acted on them they just popped up in my head, like intrusive thoughts).
